newListingSweeps.name: New listings: Gorge, Mt Hood, Rainier

regions.name: San Juans / Anacortes / Bellingham / Birch Bay
Columbia Gorge (Hood River / White Salmon / Stevenson)
Pacific City / Lincoln City / Newport / Yachats
Mount Rainier gateway (Packwood / Ashford)
regions.why: Not near the coast, but cheap land and steady national-park demand make it one of the better tiny-home and cabin markets.

regions.name: Mt Hood (Government Camp / Welches)
regions.why: Year-round ski and summer demand with high nightly rates, an hour from Portland.

regions.name: Bend / Sunriver / Sisters
regions.why: Among the highest nightly rates and occupancy in Oregon. Bend's STR spacing rules apply.

regions.name: Methow Valley (Winthrop / Mazama)
regions.why: Strong four-season demand and large rural lots suited to cabins and tiny homes.

excluded: Seattle, Bellevue, Tacoma and Everett: Seattle caps operators at two STR units, competition is heavy, and these metros would use most of the monthly API budget.
Portland and Vancouver WA: Portland only allows STRs with a resident host, so whole-home investor rentals generally aren't permitted.
Leavenworth: Chelan County and the city cap new STR permits.
Multi-family (2+ units) and apartments, and anything over $1M.
